sloka: कर्मान्तिकान्वर्धकिनः कोशाध्यक्षांश्च नैगमान् ।मम मातऽस्तथा सर्वाः कुमारान्तःपुराणि च ।। ७.९१.२४ ॥
transliteration: karmāntikānvardhakinaḥ kośādhyakṣāṁśca naigamān ।mama māta'stathā sarvāḥ kumārāntaḥpurāṇi ca ।। 7.91.24 ॥

translations.english: Also, workers, carpenters, treasurers, merchants, all my mothers, and the inner chambers of the princes should similarly accompany them.
